# SnapGrids

SnapGrids is a hosting provider for game servers, VPS hosting, web hosting, Discord bot hosting, and dedicated servers.

Primary site: https://snapgrids.store/
Sitemap: https://snapgrids.store/sitemap.xml

Important pages:
- Game server hosting: https://snapgrids.store/games
- Minecraft server hosting: https://snapgrids.store/games/minecraft
- Rust server hosting: https://snapgrids.store/games/rust
- ARK server hosting: https://snapgrids.store/games/ark
- VPS hosting: https://snapgrids.store/vps
- Other hosting services: https://snapgrids.store/otherhosting
- Web hosting: https://snapgrids.store/webhosting
- Discord bot hosting: https://snapgrids.store/discord
- Dedicated server hosting: https://snapgrids.store/dedicated

Key capabilities:
- INR pricing by default with selectable currency conversion.
- Geo-focused hosting for India, the UK, Europe, Asia, and global audiences.
- NVMe-backed hosting plans for games, websites, bots, VPS, and dedicated workloads.
- DDoS protection, low-latency connectivity, and scalable plans.
- Admin-managed game and hosting pages with editable plan category mappings.

Relevant search intents:
- cheap Indian hosting, cheap India hosting, low latency India hosting, Mumbai server hosting, Delhi VPS hosting, Bangalore VPS hosting
- cheap UK hosting, London VPS hosting, UK Minecraft server hosting, UK dedicated server hosting
- Singapore game server hosting, Frankfurt VPS hosting, Germany game server hosting, US game server hosting
- cheap Minecraft hosting, cheap Rust server hosting, Palworld hosting, ARK server hosting, Valheim server hosting, CS2 server hosting
- cheap VPS hosting, NVMe VPS hosting, web hosting India, web hosting UK, Node.js hosting India, Discord bot hosting, bare metal dedicated server hosting
